'''2007 Worlds Team Mark Peterson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team event. Deck title Chumblespuzz Esq. Jr. CCT objective.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Peterson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decsheets|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
